# Completion Report: Work Order 1 — Ledger & Delivery Engine (`internal/core/delivery/`)

## Summary of Completed Tasks

All line-item deliverables for Work Order 1 have been implemented and verified:

1. **Package Setup (`internal/core/delivery/doc.go`)**
   - Package-level documentation defining the role of the v2 delivery engine: injection ledger, ranking engine, budget enforcement, anchor verification, and exposure tracking.

2. **Channel & Moment Types (`internal/core/delivery/types.go`)**
   - Enums: [`Channel`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/types.go#L3) (`system`, `ephemeral`, `deny`) and [`Moment`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/types.go#L11) (`task_start`, `first_entry`, `first_touch`, `about_to_edit`, `error`, `gate`).
   - [`Budget`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/types.go#L23) type and [`DefaultBudgets()`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/types.go#L25) specifying default token quotas for each injection moment.

3. **Injection Record & Ledger (`internal/core/delivery/ledger.go`)**
   - Structs: [`InjectionRecord`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go#L5), [`ExposureRecord`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go#L15), [`Ledger`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go#L22).
   - Methods: [`RecordInjection`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go#L47), [`RecordPull`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go#L57), [`HasSeenDossier`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go#L66)/[`MarkDossierSeen`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go#L70), [`HasSeenAnchor`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go#L74)/[`MarkAnchorSeen`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go#L78), [`IsGateAcknowledged`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go#L82)/[`AcknowledgeGate`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go#L86), [`RearmDedup`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go#L113), [`GetExposureList`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go#L118), and [`FindInjectionAfterStep`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go#L122).

4. **Anchor Verifier (`internal/core/delivery/anchor.go`)**
   - [`VerifyAnchor`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/anchor.go#L9) verifying file/directory existence on disk (supporting symbol anchors with `:` separation).
   - [`VerifyAnchors`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/anchor.go#L23) partitioning anchor slices into valid and suspect subsets.

5. **Ranking Engine (`internal/core/delivery/ranker.go`)**
   - Composite ranking scoring: anchor match priority (+1000 exact, +500 directory, +100 scope), entry type priority (invariant through open-issue), verification bonus (+200), and evidence boost (+10 per item, capped at +50).
   - [`RankEntries`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ranker.go#L26) and greedy [`SelectWithinBudget`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/ranker.go#L102) token truncation.

6. **Content Formatter (`internal/core/delivery/formatter.go`)**
   - [`FormatEntry`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/formatter.go#L12) (`[repo-memory <id>] <type>: <text>`).
   - [`FormatEntries`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/formatter.go#L16) with contextual header/footer delimiters.
   - [`FormatGateDeny`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/formatter.go#L30) and deterministic SHA-256 [`ContentHash`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/formatter.go#L34).

7. **Delivery Engine (`internal/core/delivery/engine.go`)**
   - [`Engine`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/engine.go#L14) with options [`WithBudgets`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/engine.go#L24) and [`WithScopeResolver`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/engine.go#L30).
   - Methods: [`TaskStartEntries`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/engine.go#L113), [`DossierEntries`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/engine.go#L160), [`AnchorEntries`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/engine.go#L178), [`ErrorEntries`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/engine.go#L215), and [`GateEntries`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/engine.go#L249).
   - Respects retired filtering, suspect anchor verification pruning, per-moment budgets, and descending score sorting.

8. **Test Suite (`internal/core/delivery/delivery_test.go`)**
   - Unit tests covering ledger lifecycle, anchor verification, ranking, budget truncation, formatter output, and complete engine integration against SQLite index.
